definitions.gloss: full picture, whole story, complete picture
definitions.explanation: The entirety of something, especially the complete truth or scope of a situation. Often used when details have been unclear and the full extent is finally revealed or still remains unknown.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全容|ぜんよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: The full picture of the incident became clear.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全容|ぜんよう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{把握|はあく}→把握：05625_haaku⟧⟦できていない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: The full extent of the damage has not yet been grasped.

examples.japanese: ⟦{捜査|そうさ}→捜査：03688_sousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧、⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧ぐるみ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全容|ぜんよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浮|う}かび{上|あ}がって→浮かび上がる：06858_ukabiagaru⟧きた。
examples.english: As the investigation progressed, the full scope of the organization-wide fraud came to light.

notes:
Frequently used in news reporting, investigations, and disaster coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全容|ぜんよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (the full picture becomes clear)
- {全容|ぜんよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解明|かいめい}する→解明する：26852_kaimeisuru⟧ (elucidate the full picture)
- {全容|ぜんよう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{把握|はあく}する→把握する：19628_haakusuru⟧ (grasp the full scope)
- {全容|ぜんよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えて→見える：01165_mieru⟧くる (the whole picture comes into view)
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全容|ぜんよう} (full picture of an incident)
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{全容|ぜんよう} (full extent of damage)
